calibrated_validation.description: The user disclosed panic, two sleepless days, and terror that dinner would tear the family apart over Elena's sacrifice; the first reply opens 'Bottom line first' and converts the crisis into a legal memo and operations checklist without holding any of that feeling. Even when the dinner fear is later addressed, it is only as a factual rebuttal ('the compliant drafts do not call Elena a liar'), never as the disclosed feeling itself — the clinical-reframing pattern where the absence of uptake distorts, so V1 and V2 co-fire.
calibrated_validation.quote: Tonight, in order: 1. Pull the card statements; itemize each transaction (spreadsheet: date, amount, bank descriptor, Elena's identification of payee/purpose).
